# ⚙️ CI/CD Workflows (`.github/workflows/`)

Autonomous GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines for Forge micro-apps.

---

## 📦 Active Workflows

* **[`pipeline.yml`](pipeline.yml)**: Continuous integration runner executing `./run.sh setup`, `./run.sh verify` (18 checks), and `./run.sh test` (5 test tiers).
* **[`dco.yml`](dco.yml)**: Developer Certificate of Origin 1.1 verification ensuring all commits carry `Signed-off-by:` trailers.
